name: IPEVO Corporation
summary: IPEVO Corporation, founded in 1996 in Taipei City, Taiwan, specializes in the design, research, development, and sale of computer peripheral hardware products. Their diverse hardware offerings primarily feature a range of video collaboration and teaching cameras, including popular models like the DO-CAM and V4K, as well as HDMI/USB dual-mode and wireless teaching cameras. Accompanying these are accessories such as uplift video phone holders, laptop mirror cameras, flip learning mirrors, and specialized teaching camera bags. Complementing their hardware, the company also develops a comprehensive suite of software applications. These include AI-driven tools like IPEVO EyeStage for smart video, general visualizer software, and utility applications such as CamControl for managing camera functions and image settings. They also offer IPEVO Annotator for screen annotation, capture, and recording; IPEVO VirtualCam Controller for virtual camera creation and image manipulation; iDocCam, which converts smartphones into teaching cameras; and the IPEVO WHITEBOARD APP for interactive drawing and presentation.
